title: Batch G / Deep Session6: source-native to repository contract review
review_kind: research mapping only; no converted or admitted records

contract_layers.authority: Immutable delivery revision 1; its property names and local IDs are deliverable-local, not repository field names.
contract_layers.mapping_role: Preserve all source labels, attributed claims and unknowns without coercion.

contract_layers.authority: tools/evidence_program/contracts/dataset.schema.json; five per-type wrappers; static reading of validate_dataset.py
contract_layers.mapping_role: Actual repository-contained proposal fields, not the production import format. Supports source_artifact, actor, statement, incident and resource_observation shapes.

Existing organization/source/sourceItem/participant/evidence/statement schemas. No incident or resource_observation type is defined in this inspected canonical contract. Production statement requires person_slug; organization speaker cannot be mapped directly.

global_admission_blockers: This report proposes field correspondences only. No live schema record or adapter output is produced.

The input normally records retrieval on a calendar date, not a verified UTC instant. Proposal known_at/retrieved_at require UTC timestamps; production observed_at likewise requires a timestamp. Do not invent midnight or backdate to publication.
Many input assertions are paraphrases or field summaries, not short verbatim original_text. A complete native statement cannot be fabricated from a paraphrase and rights remain artifact-specific.
Supplied INM003, INM006, CGP001 and CGP001-A1 identify research catalog context. They are not verified organization, source item, statement, incident or legacy ledger keys.

Existing schema enums cannot encode all source legal/administrative statuses, authority levels, date roles, dependence edges or cohort relationships. Preserve them outside the closed native data objects.
All real claims require identity, rights, source-locator and semantic review before conversion. Shape validation neither supplies those reviews nor grants publication rights.

field_mapping.rule: Keep local artifact IDs as sidecar crosswalks. Assign repository IDs only in a future authorized adapter. Native document/docket IDs may be upstream identifiers after exact source and release validation; not current record IDs.
field_mapping.sidecar_preservation: Original local ID, native ID, docket context, version labels; an upstream_ref needs dataset/release/schema/source_ref and transformations, not only a document ID.

field_mapping.rule: URL maps directly in meaning but remains subject to native URI/production public URL checks. Use only an established source-language title; source_kind is not a substitute for an unknown title. Proposal report/other may fit document genres; production SOURCE_TYPES has no report/order enum.
field_mapping.sidecar_preservation: Full source_kind and source title provenance. A court order is not necessarily a press item merely because that enum exists.

field_mapping.rule: The five retained FTC PDF SHA-256 values can be preserved as source-byte hashes with their exact provenance. Unknown body hashes stay absent in proposal; production sourceItem requires either content_hash or content_hash_input. Research-ledger hash is never a hash of the source body. Production content_hash meaning and canonicalization must be checked against the future importer; a PDF byte hash is not automatically an interchangeable canonical-content hash merely because both satisfy the SHA-256 shape.
field_mapping.sidecar_preservation: Byte count, document packaging metadata, source version scope, retrieval representation, limited inspection extent. Never fabricate a version history or use technical metadata as a correction.

field_mapping.rule: Availability and inspection are separate. Retrieval failure may support unknown availability and a precise failure sidecar; it does not establish removal. Partially read documents are not fully reviewed sources.
field_mapping.sidecar_preservation: For two failed artifacts retain failure reason, unverified identity and zero admitted content claims. Do not create statements from their URLs.

field_mapping.rule: Resolve named organizations separately. Publisher hosting a document does not become its declarant or a verifier. Use organization actor for institution-authored statements; leave unestablished authors absent. Production participant can name an organization but production statement requires a person.
field_mapping.sidecar_preservation: OPC regulator, FSNI operator, FTC agency, court, respondent and republisher roles stay distinct; authority, procedural role and whether a statement quotes another organization remain explicit.

field_mapping.rule: Only established identity mappings become aliases or external IDs. Anonymous source-local companies/websites are not named identities. Empty incident subject_refs are structurally permitted; resource subject_refs must contain a genuine measured subject. Do not use the reporting regulator as the measured subject simply to satisfy that minimum.
field_mapping.sidecar_preservation: Everalbum/Paravision continuity is source-attributed. No invented people, corporate-registry verification, anonymous reidentification or June-November subject joins. Geography of actions is not automatically actor registration.

field_mapping.rule: Preserve original Chinese procedure wording and the English gloss as a distinct normalization, with review limits. Numbers explicitly asserted by a source are explicit_numeric, not model-inferred probabilities. Field summaries lacking a source-language quote need additional preparation.
field_mapping.sidecar_preservation: All original strings, qualifiers, structured scope, legal dates and content-rights limits. The statement shape has no numeric result field; numbers in prose do not become a quantitative observation automatically.

field_mapping.rule: Current statementSchema requires a non-null person slug, while participantSchema permits an organization. Do not invent a person to represent an institution or claim that an organization participant removes the statement constraint.
field_mapping.sidecar_preservation: Keep institutional assertions in the reviewed source-native ledger/proposal mapping until a separately authorized design/adapter decision.

field_mapping.rule: Link the exact captured artifact revision and preserve locator. Reading a document supports that it makes a claim, not necessarily the underlying claim. Proposed relations are supports/contradicts/context. Record the actual extraction method; do not falsely mark model-produced synthesis as purely manual.
field_mapping.sidecar_preservation: Inspection text versus visual review, source-body capture, source authority, uninspected underlying inputs and independent outcome verification remain separate.

field_mapping.rule: Proposal date and range/precision support day, month and year precision; unknown requires a reason. Use a date only when its role is established. A source-local time with unknown timezone cannot be promoted to UTC. Production nullable timestamps do not preserve coarse dates alone.
field_mapping.sidecar_preservation: Keep signature, filing, issued, effective, deadline anchor, completion, listing, publication, coverage and metadata dates separately. One times.event field cannot losslessly carry all these roles.

field_mapping.rule: Do not convert a retrieval date to invented midnight. Ledger creation time proves ledger creation, not each source capture time. Future dataset registration may record its actual system time with a disclosed provenance boundary; it does not recover original capture instants.
field_mapping.sidecar_preservation: Preserve original calendar retrieval date and ledger creation timestamp, with missing per-artifact instants explicit.

field_mapping.rule: These narrative fields may summarize legal/procedural evidence but there is no dedicated native authority/decision/remedy/compliance schema in the inspected contract. Source verification never maps automatically to incident.verification=confirmed.
field_mapping.sidecar_preservation: Allegation, settlement/limited admission, court order, administrative order, instruction, respondent assertion, regulator inspection, prospective remedy, exceptions, completion and independent validation stay separately structured in research.

field_mapping.rule: An incident represents an alleged/observed harmful event; a document, guidance, remedy order, enforcement count or renamed respondent is not automatically another event. Curated cluster key, taxonomy and severity rubric require explicit choices. AI association alone does not establish causation.
field_mapping.sidecar_preservation: No source-local chain ID is automatically a deduplication_key. Hold impact and verification selection until event scope and supporting evidence are adjudicated; no admission performed.

field_mapping.rule: Only separately reviewed metrics and subjects can become observations. resource_kind=other is a shape escape hatch, not evidence that incident/enforcement activity belongs in a resource series. Preserve decimal strings and source units; counts of images, people, alerts, apps, websites, enterprises and actions remain distinct.
field_mapping.sidecar_preservation: There is no structured numerator/denominator/population/cohort-link object in measurement. metric.definition/context and scope can describe them but do not losslessly enforce source semantics. Keep the original structures as sidecars.

field_mapping.rule: Tag missing values with the correct source reason; null is not zero. A phrase like up to an estimated count with incomplete ascertainment is not automatically a universal mathematical upper_bound. Review the exact estimand before representing a point or bound.
field_mapping.sidecar_preservation: Store estimation language, covered subset, ascertainment defects and every unresolved linkage. Do not calculate a failure, success, deletion or remediation rate here.

field_mapping.rule: record.supersedes is the immediately preceding revision of the same record, not an instrument that legally supersedes another instrument. Statement relations only updates/clarifies/retracts/contradicts/repeats; use only when the semantic relationship is established.
field_mapping.sidecar_preservation: Preserve legal supersession, links_to, republished_by, claims_compliance_with, unresolved_conflicting_totals, same_source_case and possible_indexing as native sidecar relationships. No formal correction inferred from differing counts or newer packaging.

field_mapping.rule: Rights are per artifact/content category; do not inherit a website policy for third-party attachments or another byte version. Keep internal/needs_review until a later authorized rights decision. A URL, official hosting or known hash is not permission.
field_mapping.sidecar_preservation: OPC CC BY version is unverified; third-party FSNI/Scarlatti excluded. FTC policy does not clear respondent filings or mixed court package. Chinese copyright notices and republisher credits establish no affirmative grant.

field_mapping.rule: Text inspection and manual reasoning annotations do not establish native human_verified without the required named human reviewer and review time. Schema-machine validity is not an incident verification verdict.
field_mapping.sidecar_preservation: Keep source-attribution verification, factual outcome verification, causal attribution, rights clearance and publication approval distinct. All original acceptance runtime results remain null.

field_mapping.rule: Retain research catalog IDs as sidecar context, not native ledger keys. AIID 619 and 665 are uninspected possible index references, not corroboration or extra incidents.
field_mapping.sidecar_preservation: No AIID per-case assignment, no agent-security catalog overlap review, no new inventory discovery, no production legacy_refs emitted.

actor_boundary_rules.rule: Keep regulator author and operator subject/claimant distinct; no implied regulator verification of current operator claim.
Hosting on ftc.gov does not change authorship of respondent compliance declarations or court orders; preserve instrument-specific authority.
Source-attributed name continuity within one FTC matter; legal d/b/a statement and respondent name-change claim are separate evidence. Not a new event.
Differentiate publisher/summary author, unnamed acting local authority, and anonymous regulated subject; no named entity invented.

actor_boundary_rules.actor: 江苏网信网 / 网信上海 / 上海市网信办
actor_boundary_rules.rule: Publisher, credited source and asserting authority are separately attributed. Upstream article identity and exact reproduction remain unverified.
Maintain source-local labels and mixed units. Do not coerce a population into a fictitious person or reuse a collective identity across notices without evidence.

chain_boundary_review.review: One trial/inquiry context with multiple claims and count units; nine recorded misidentifications do not supply nine deduplicated native incident rows. General guidance, later operator claim and prospective safeguards are not additional incidents.

Separate allegations, court/bankruptcy/admin documents and prospective remedy clauses; linked proceedings have distinct native docket identities. Five-year ban and 45-day deadline cannot receive calendar ends from an unverified effective date.
Keep alleged conduct, operative order, respondent deletion claim, corporate-name claim and later agency summary distinct; Closed status does not independently verify deletion.
Anonymous source-local case; notice reports findings and an offline order, not checked completion.
One described anonymous company, two websites; count of websites does not establish two cases or events.

The explicit instruction → return-check of three enterprises → escalation chain is supported within the notice. It reports recurrence/noncompliance, not successful remediation. Do not join its three to November.

Document-level aggregate activity bundle, not one event or a unified cohort. Keep 54 apps, 26 websites, 3 websites and 5 websites separately scoped; neither disjointness nor subset identity is established.

Statement relationship enum has five values; evidence relation has three; upstream crosswalk is not a general dependence graph.
Incident verification enum does not represent the full authority/performance matrix.
One rights_state/basis/url per record cannot enforce mixed-source component rights or historical scope automatically.

semantic_gaps.native_limit: Production statementSchema requires a person; proposal organizational attribution is not a production adapter.

semantic_gaps.native_limit: Mathematical bound shape cannot encode incomplete ascertainment unless estimand and caveat retained.
semantic_gaps.preserve: source qualifier and uncertainty; do not coerce estimated up-to into universal maximum

inspection_execution_limits.schema_probes: Separate invented fixtures only, Draft202012Validator with offline registry and FormatChecker; no original source values or original acceptance cases are executed.
inspection_execution_limits.validator: validate_dataset.py read statically but not imported or executed. Listed reference, rights, revision and unit invariants are code-inspection findings only.
inspection_execution_limits.production: Zod code and enums inspected statically; no TypeScript, helper code, production validator or database executed.
inspection_execution_limits.research: No executable research artifact or source-provided script executed; JSON read as inert data only.
